_comment: Super Mario collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed super-star-power-up` (since #24 collections may share lines; picks take never-used lines first), then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_mario.py.

readme.title: Super Mario
readme.summary: Pokemon dressed as power-ups and plumbing heroes (original patterns inspired by the Super Mario games).
looks: each line wears one look: a red mushroom cap with white spots (Morelull, Chansey, Spinda); fire flower, white over red with a flower emblem and glowing fireballs (Heatmor, Oricorio, Bellsprout); super star, star gold flashing every colour when invincible (Pachirisu, Ralts, Psyduck); golden ? blocks over a brick base, the ? marks blinking (Pumpkaboo, Bramblin, Lapras); plumber, a red shirt, blue overalls with gold buttons and brown boots (Kubfu, Meditite, Indeedee); koopa shell, green shell plates over yellow skin (Dewpider, Woobat, Darkrai)
the eyes keep their own colours
shiny: the other power-up colours: the green 1-up mushroom, the ice flower, blue underground blocks, green shirt and navy overalls, a red shell
